pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: 2-story main body, house rotated about 5.4 deg (west edge (394,364) to (419,642)); nearly a pyramid: a small flat cap about 8 ft across at (490-533,484-531) with hips to all four corners; the west slope is the same plane as the NW wing west slope; the east slope sweeps past x 600 with no break down to a low east eave at x 660-672 (LiDAR eave about 10 ft there vs 20 ft on the west); north eave of this block at about y 447 for x 516-580 (the flat patio cover fills y 362-447 there); dark faces at (470-560,400-480) are N-facing, not flat

pieces.name: nw_wing
pieces.notes: 2-story N-S hip wing on the NW, ridge at x about 458 from y 383 to 473, dark N-facing triangle at the north eave (apex near (455,400)); ridge lower than the main cap and dies into the main north slope; east eave at x about 510

pieces.name: ne_low
pieces.notes: 1-story hip at the NE, north eave at y about 370 from x 580 to 650, dark N-facing triangle (590-640,372-400) so the ridge is N-S at about x 612 and runs south into the main east slope; its east face is continuous with the main sweeping east face

pieces.name: se_bump
pieces.notes: small raised hip bump at the SE corner over the low east eave, N-S ridge near x 639 with a nearly flat top (LiDAR pitch 1); it casts the NW-going shadow line (653,565) to (633,595) onto the main east slope

exclude_notes: pool and pool deck north of the roof; the trace runs up to y 308 there
dark inside corner between the NW wing and the NE block: shadowed patio cover (LiDAR shows a 2-pitch surface at about 14 ft), not roof
deck strip above the NE block eave
tree canopy over the SW corner eave
tree canopy over the south eave
notes: Rotated (5.4 deg) 2-story hip house: pyramid-like main with a tiny flat cap, a N-S hip wing on the NW, a 1-story hip at the NE, and a small raised hip bump at the SE corner. Trace overshoots badly to the north (pool deck) and the inside corner is a shadowed patio cover. Confidence med: piece split and the big north exclusion are clear; medium on the main ridge direction (cap is tiny, diagonal in LiDAR) and on whether the patio cover between the wings should count as roof (excluded here as a patio).
